name: Awards & Honours
summary: Civilian awards (Bharat Ratna, Padma), Gallantry awards, Literary, Cinema, and Sports honours.
concept: Covers highest civilian honours (Bharat Ratna instituted 1954, first awarded to C. Rajagopalachari, S. Radhakrishnan, C. V. Raman), Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri, wartime gallantry (Param Vir Chakra, Maha Vir Chakra, Vir Chakra), peacetime gallantry (Ashoka Chakra, Kirti Chakra, Shaurya Chakra), and cultural honours (Dadasaheb Phalke, Jnanpith).

subtopics.name: Civilian Honours & Bharat Ratna
subtopics.summary: Bharat Ratna order of precedence, recipients, regulations.

facts.title: First Bharat Ratna Recipients (1954)
facts.content: Awarded to scholar-statesman C. Rajagopalachari, philosopher-president Dr. S. Radhakrishnan, and Nobel laureate physicist Dr. C. V. Raman.

facts.title: Foreign Recipients of Bharat Ratna
facts.content: Only two non-Indian citizens have received the Bharat Ratna: Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan (1987) and Nelson Mandela (1990).

mcqs.questionText: Who shared the 2014 Nobel Peace Prize with Malala Yousafzai for spearheading the 'Bachpan Bachao Andolan' against child labor?

mcqs.questionTextHi: बाल श्रम के विरुद्ध 'बचपन बचाओ आंदोलन' का नेतृत्व करने के लिए 2014 में मलाला यूसुफजई के साथ संयुक्त रूप से शांति का नोबेल पुरस्कार किसे दिया गया?
mcqs.exp: Kailash Satyarthi founded the 'Bachpan Bachao Andolan' (Save the Childhood Movement) in 1980 and has rescued over 100,000 children from trafficking and bonded labor across India.
mcqs.explanation: Kailash Satyarthi founded the 'Bachpan Bachao Andolan' (Save the Childhood Movement) in 1980 and has rescued over 100,000 children from trafficking and bonded labor across India.
